home.hero.title: Neuro-rehabilitation, led by clinicians, delivered online
home.hero.body: Nourish the Nerve supports people living with neurological conditions through assessment, therapy and rehabilitation you can attend from home.
home.about.body: Care is planned and delivered by qualified clinicians, and every patient has a named clinician responsible for their programme. Appointments, exercises and progress notes live in one place, so nothing is lost between sessions.
home.services.heading: What we offer
home.blog.heading: Latest articles
home.blog.intro: Practical writing from our clinicians on living with and recovering from neurological conditions.
home.workshops.heading: Upcoming workshops
home.workshops.intro: Small-group sessions for patients, families and carers.
home.testimonials.heading: What our patients say
home.contact.body: Appointments and new patient accounts are arranged over WhatsApp, so you can speak to a person before anything else happens.
services.item.assessment.title: Neurological assessment
services.item.assessment.body: A structured first appointment that establishes where you are now and what a realistic programme looks like.
services.item.physiotherapy.title: Neurological physiotherapy
services.item.physiotherapy.body: Movement, balance and strength work built around your own goals and reviewed as they change.
services.item.occupational.title: Occupational therapy
services.item.occupational.body: Getting back to the everyday tasks that matter to you, with adaptations where they help.
services.item.speech.title: Speech and language therapy
services.item.speech.body: Support with speech, communication and swallowing difficulties following neurological injury or illness.
services.item.cognitive.title: Cognitive rehabilitation
services.item.cognitive.body: Strategies for memory, attention and fatigue, practised between sessions and adjusted with you.
